title: Normalized magic definition (legacy magics domain)
description: Contract for one normalized magic: one stored legacy magics entry. Native integer id and costs are kept verbatim (rule T3); the embedded-JSON area string coerces to an integer array (rule T2); name, description, and img_name are verbatim asset strings recorded, never validated (rule T3). See packages/game-content/README.md for the rule set and survey citations.

legacy_id.description: Stored magics id preserved verbatim as a string (rule T4): the decimal form of the native integer id.

kind.description: Classification of the stored magics domain: every magics entry maps to magic.

source_file.description: Origin file of the stored entry: config/main.json (no patch targets magics).

source_layer.description: Layering origin: stored (no patch targets magics).

content_version.description: Content fingerprint (sha256 over the stored source bytes plus the mods list); sources carry no version stamp.

id.description: Native stored magics id, kept verbatim (rule T3).

mana.description: Native stored mana cost, kept verbatim (rule T3).

level.description: Native stored unlock level, kept verbatim (rule T3).

gold.description: Native stored gold cost, kept verbatim (rule T3).

cash.description: Native stored cash cost, kept verbatim (rule T3).

target.description: Native stored targeting mode, kept verbatim as an opaque code (rule T3).

area.description: Spell area offsets coerced from the embedded-JSON string to an integer array (rule T2); formation data recorded, never treated as item references.

img_name.description: Spell icon asset name, recorded verbatim and never validated; asset truth belongs to M4 (rule T3).
